title: BUG: LocalPythonExecutor unable to handle nested for loop
author: SingCheng

comments.author: suryabdev
comments.body:
Hi, Thanks for raising this issue. I was able to reproduce the error
```
    raise InterpreterError(
smolagents.local_python_executor.InterpreterError: Code execution failed at line 'map: Dict[Tuple[str, str], str] = {
    (s_name, e.name): e.string_A
    for s_name, s_struct in structureA.items()
    for e in s_struct.list_A
}' due to: InterpreterError: The variable `e` is not defined.
```

I created PR https://github.com/huggingface/smolagents/pull/1823 with a fix, After the change the code example seems to be working fine
(Note: With the example as is I was getting `InterpreterError: Cannot assign to name 'map': doing this would erase the existing tool!` because the map variable clashes with the in-built map tool/function. Renaming the `map` variable printed the expected output)
```
CodeOutput(output=None, logs="{(<ClassC.ABC: 'ABC'>, <ClassB.valueA: 'one'>): 'vvv', (<ClassC.ABC: 'ABC'>, <ClassB.valueB: 'two'>): 'sss', (<ClassC.ABC: 'ABC'>, <ClassB.valueC: 'three'>): 'ddde'}\n", is_final_answer=False)
```
